title: National public-sector strike begun January 11; union suspension reported February 6
notes: Search results say the national public-sector strike began Jan 11 and was formally suspended by unions Feb 6; school absences reportedly continued after suspension. The Feb 6 suspension is not proof the physical work stoppage effects ended that day. Work stoppage is not coded as a February public assembly. Exact BeInChad URL is held after a prior exact HTTP 406 in Chad Jan; no copy requested. No separate February street gathering connected to the strike was established.
